event: Atlético Dallas signed Javier 'Chicharito' Hernández to a two-year contract with a club option for a third year, making him the expansion club's first-ever player ahead of their 2027 USL Championship debut.

Atlético Dallas announced plans to play home matches at the Cotton Bowl (capacity 92,100) upon their 2027 USL Championship debut, establishing one of the largest venue footprints in the league's history.
Rhode Island FC loaned midfielder Clay Holstad to MLS club FC Dallas for the remainder of the 2026 season with a purchase option, making Holstad the first RIFC player ever to move to MLS.

FC Tulsa defeated reigning USL Championship champions Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC 1-0 at FNB Stadium via Logan Dorsey's 13th-minute long-range strike, earning Dane Jacomen's third consecutive clean sheet.

Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC fell 0-1 to FC Tulsa in a rematch of the 2025 USL Championship Final, dropping below .500 for the 2026 season (7W-8L-2D, 23 pts) and losing consecutive league matches for the first time this year.
Louisville City FC defeated Birmingham Legion FC 2-1 at Lynn Family Stadium via a Kevon Lambert brace, recording consecutive USL Championship wins for the first time since March.
Birmingham Legion FC conceded a 2-1 defeat to Louisville City FC at Lynn Family Stadium.
Pittsburgh introduced Seattle Sounders loan signee Yu Tsukanome as a second-half substitute against FC Tulsa, marking the player's debut with the club.
Flint City Bucks secured their 11th Central Conference title with a 4-0 win in the conference semifinal, advancing to host the 2026 USL League Two Final on August 1 at Atwood Stadium.
Vermont Green FC advanced to the 2026 USL League Two Final at Atwood Stadium in Flint, Michigan, attempting to become the first repeat League Two champion in 23 years.
AC Boise posted a per-game home attendance average above 7,200 fans across every home match of their inaugural USL League One season, the highest consistent attendance figure in the league.
San Antonio FC hosted Indy Eleven at Toyota Field in a scheduled USL Championship regular-season match.
Charleston Battery hosted Brooklyn FC at Patriots Point in a scheduled USL Championship regular-season match.
Brooklyn FC traveled to Patriots Point to face Charleston Battery in a USL Championship regular-season match in the expansion club's debut season.
